rec.name: Sub-Collection Bubble Navigation (Sectionfy)

what.text: A Sectionfy 'Sub-collections' section that shows a row of linked sub-collections or categories as round (or square) image bubbles with a label under each, for example Starter Set, Refill Pack, Fastenzeit 2025 and Bio Gemüsebrühe. It sits directly under the hero and press-logo bar. The ticket (originally titled 'Sub-collection to full width') led to an alignment option (Left / Center) so the items can be centered when only a few are maintained. The same option was then added to the general Sectionfy section.

why.text: Image bubbles give shoppers an immediate, visual way into the main product groups or offers, which cuts clicks and decision effort. Centering a short row keeps it balanced and intentional instead of looking left-heavy or half-empty. That keeps the navigation credible and easy to scan. The seasonal bubble (Fastenzeit 2025) also lets the team promote current offers above the fold.

how.text: Add the 'Sub-collections' section to the template, below the hero and logo bar. Use 'Add Collection' to add one block per sub-collection, each with an image, a label and a link. Set style to 'Show bubbles' and image style to Circle or Square. Set image size (desktop and mobile), font size, text color and gap between items. Set Positioning to Static or Absolute and Alignment to Left or Center. Use Center when only a few items are maintained so the row is centered across the full width. Custom CSS is available for further tweaks.

items: Image size for mobile: e.g. 65 px
Font size for mobile: e.g. 14 px
Gap between items (desktop): up to 100 px

dependencies.text: Shopify theme with the Sectionfy sub-collections section and its 'Add Collection' blocks. Sub-collections must exist, with images maintained for each bubble. No metafields or external apps are visible in the source.

items: Collection page entry rate from the home page
Bounce rate on the home page
Share of clicks on the seasonal or promo bubble

images.caption: Live home page: bubble row of four sub-collections under the hero and press logos (the red box marks the area that needed centering/full width).
Settings panel: font sizes, text color, gap between items (desktop/mobile) and Positioning.
Theme editor with the Sub-collections section; the red circle highlights the new Alignment (Left / Center) option.
